Mandarin cái — Conditional Inference Tree

Three-panel figure reproduction and inspectable R source

Static, source-backed preview — not an R Markdown Knit. The three figures below are the original uploaded PNGs. The complete R code is included further down and in plot_three_panels_from_csv.R. To create a freshly R-executed HTML report, knit three_panel_ctree_report.Rmd in RStudio.

What is shown?

The displayed pathways are drawn from an existing final conditional inference tree using 30 contextual predictors and 2,000 tokens. The 34-terminal-node tree is not refitted here. Panel (a) shows upper-level splitting and paths to CAI3 and CAI5; Panel (b) expands Node 11 to CAI4; Panel (c) expands Node 12 to CAI1 and CAI2. Collapsed nodes are diagrammatic omissions, not statistical pruning.

# ==============================================================================
# Conditional Inference Tree Figures (3 Separate Panels)
# 绘画风格 100% 不变，修正：
#   1. 字号回调至适中比例（不拥挤、右上角图例不裁切）
#   2. 补足左侧 left_pad 与画布宽度，最左侧根节点框完整显示不贴边
#   3. 保持树状图紧贴顶端图例
# ==============================================================================

if (!requireNamespace("ggplot2", quietly = TRUE)) {
  stop("Please install ggplot2: install.packages('ggplot2')")
}

# ------- 1. Configuration -----------------------------------------------------
# Relative paths: run this script from the repository root.
# No personal computer paths are required or included.
RESULTS_DIR <- file.path(getwd(), "data")
OUT_DIR     <- file.path(getwd(), "figures", "generated")
dir.create(OUT_DIR, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

UPPER_DEPTH        <- 2L
SHOW_BRANCH_LABELS <- TRUE
EXTRA_CA1_LEAF_ID  <- 29L

node_file <- file.path(RESULTS_DIR, "08_vertical_tree_nodes_full.csv")
edge_file <- file.path(RESULTS_DIR, "09_vertical_tree_edges_full.csv")
if (!file.exists(node_file) || !file.exists(edge_file)) {
  stop("Required node/edge CSVs are missing from data/. See README.md for the expected filenames.")
}

nodes <- utils::read.csv(node_file, check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
                         fileEncoding = "UTF-8-BOM")
edges <- utils::read.csv(edge_file, check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
                         fileEncoding = "UTF-8-BOM")

req_nodes <- c("id", "depth", "terminal", "variable", "pvalue", "pred_class", "n")
req_edges <- c("from", "to", "branch", "branch_label")
stopifnot(all(req_nodes %in% names(nodes)), all(req_edges %in% names(edges)))

nodes$id       <- as.integer(nodes$id)
nodes$depth    <- as.integer(nodes$depth)
nodes$n        <- as.numeric(nodes$n)
nodes$terminal <- as.logical(nodes$terminal)
edges$from     <- as.integer(edges$from)
edges$to       <- as.integer(edges$to)

root_id <- setdiff(nodes$id, edges$to)
if (length(root_id) != 1L) stop("The input does not contain exactly one root.")

edges$branch <- as.character(edges$branch)
edges <- edges[order(match(edges$branch, c("left", "right"))), , drop = FALSE]

# ------- Source-data validation (no model refitting) ----------------------------
stopifnot(nrow(nodes) == 67L, nrow(edges) == 66L,
          sum(nodes$terminal, na.rm = TRUE) == 34L,
          !anyDuplicated(nodes$id),
          all(edges$from %in% nodes$id), all(edges$to %in% nodes$id),
          length(root_id) == 1L,
          nodes$n[match(root_id, nodes$id)] == 2000L,
          sum(nodes$n[nodes$terminal]) == 2000L)
for (node_id in edges$from[!duplicated(edges$from)]) {
  parent_n <- nodes$n[match(node_id, nodes$id)]
  child_n  <- nodes$n[match(edges$to[edges$from == node_id], nodes$id)]
  stopifnot(length(child_n) == 2L, isTRUE(all.equal(parent_n, sum(child_n))))
}

children <- function(id) edges$to[edges$from == id]
row_of   <- function(ids) match(ids, nodes$id)

descendant_leaf_count <- function(id) {
  todo <- id
  count <- 0L
  while (length(todo)) {
    cur <- todo[1L]
    todo <- todo[-1L]
    if (isTRUE(nodes$terminal[row_of(cur)])) {
      count <- count + 1L
    } else {
      todo <- c(children(cur), todo)
    }
  }
  count
}

ancestor_ids <- function(id, stop_at = root_id) {
  ans <- id
  while (id != stop_at) {
    p <- edges$from[match(id, edges$to)]
    if (length(p) != 1L || is.na(p)) stop("Broken parent link for node ", id)
    ans <- c(ans, p)
    id <- p
  }
  unique(ans)
}

largest_leaf_for <- function(cls) {
  x <- nodes[nodes$terminal & !is.na(nodes$pred_class) &
               tolower(nodes$pred_class) == cls, , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(x) == 0L) stop("No terminal node predicts ", cls)
  x$id[which.max(x$n)]
}

all_5_largest    <- vapply(paste0("cai", 1:5), largest_leaf_for, integer(1L))
extra_ids        <- if (EXTRA_CA1_LEAF_ID %in% nodes$id[nodes$terminal]) EXTRA_CA1_LEAF_ID else integer(0)
all_focal_leaves <- unique(c(unname(all_5_largest), extra_ids))

# ------- 2. Clean linguistic labels & number formatting -----------------------
var_short <- c(
  predicate_lexical_semantic_class = "Predicate lexical class",
  reference_boundary_type          = "Reference boundary",
  quant_position                   = "Quantity position",
  modal_after_cai                  = "Post-cái modal",
  pre_cai_semantic_class           = "Pre-cái semantics",
  pre_cai_constituent_syntax       = "Pre-cái syntax",
  recent_time_expression           = "Recent-time expr.",
  subordinate_relation             = "Subordinate relation",
  clause_status                    = "Clause status",
  complement_type                  = "Complement type",
  vendler_situation_type           = "Situation type",
  postverbal_le                    = "Postverbal -le",
  cause_purpose_marker_type        = "Cause/purpose marker",
  negation_relative_position       = "Negation position",
  cai_linear_position              = "Linear position of cái"
)

short_variable <- function(v) {
  if (is.na(v) || !nzchar(v)) return("")
  if (v %in% names(var_short)) unname(var_short[[v]]) else gsub("_", " ", v)
}

fmt_p <- function(p) {
  if (is.na(p) || !is.finite(p)) return("")
  if (p < .001) "p < .001" else paste0("p = ", sub("^0", "", sprintf("%.3f", p)))
}

fmt_n <- function(num) formatC(as.integer(round(num)), format = "d", big.mark = ",")

clean_edge_label <- function(raw_vec, max_chars = 18L) {
  dict <- c(
    "copular_classificatory" = "copular/classif.",
    "copular_classificat."   = "copular/classif.",
    "cog_perc"               = "cogn./percept.",
    "existential"            = "exist.",
    "epistemic_future"       = "epistemic/fut.",
    "ability_permission"     = "ability/perm.",
    "other_rare"             = "other",
    "quantitative"           = "quant.",
    "entity_participant"     = "entity",
    "entity_part."           = "entity",
    "directional"            = "dir.",
    "complement"             = "compl.",
    "duration"               = "dur./time",
    "conditional"            = "cond.",
    "independent"            = "indep.",
    "coordinate"             = "coord.",
    "activity"               = "activ."
  )
  vapply(raw_vec, function(s) {
    if (is.na(s) || !nzchar(trimws(s))) return("")
    s <- gsub("^\\{|\\}$", "", trimws(s))
    parts <- trimws(strsplit(s, ",")[[1L]])
    has_ellipsis <- any(parts %in% c("..", "..."))
    parts <- parts[!parts %in% c("..", "...")]
    
    cleaned <- vapply(parts, function(tok) {
      hit <- names(dict)[vapply(names(dict), function(k) {
        startsWith(tok, substr(k, 1, min(7, nchar(k))))
      }, logical(1L))]
      if (length(hit) >= 1L) return(unname(dict[[hit[1L]]]))
      tok <- gsub("_", "/", tok)
      if (nchar(tok) > 10L) paste0(substr(tok, 1L, 9L), ".") else tok
    }, character(1L))
    
    if (length(cleaned) == 0L) return("")
    out <- cleaned[1L]
    if (length(cleaned) >= 2L) {
      cand <- paste0(cleaned[1L], ", ", cleaned[2L])
      if (nchar(cand) <= max_chars - 2L) {
        out <- if (length(cleaned) > 2L || has_ellipsis) paste0(cand, ", \u2026") else cand
      } else {
        out <- paste0(cleaned[1L], ", \u2026")
      }
    } else if (has_ellipsis) {
      out <- paste0(out, ", \u2026")
    }
    out
  }, character(1L))
}

# ------- 4. Build Panels (a), (b), and (c) ------------------------------------
make_subtree_display <- function(
    subroot,
    core_ids,
    focal_leaves,
    zoom_links    = character(0),
    x_step        = 3.55,
    y_step        = 1.52,
    internal_lift = 0.65
) {
  core_ids <- unique(as.integer(core_ids))
  internal_core <- core_ids[!nodes$terminal[row_of(core_ids)]]
  shown_ids <- unique(c(subroot, core_ids, edges$to[edges$from %in% internal_core]))
  
  nd <- nodes[row_of(shown_ids), , drop = FALSE]
  ed <- edges[edges$from %in% internal_core & edges$to %in% shown_ids, , drop = FALSE]
  
  nd$collapsed         <- !nd$terminal & !(nd$id %in% core_ids)
  nd$zoom_note         <- ifelse(as.character(nd$id) %in% names(zoom_links),
                                 unname(zoom_links[as.character(nd$id)]), "")
  nd$is_zoom_link      <- nd$collapsed & nzchar(nd$zoom_note)
  nd$is_leaf_like      <- (nd$terminal | nd$collapsed) & (nd$id != subroot)
  nd$n_original_leaves <- vapply(nd$id, descendant_leaf_count, integer(1L))
  nd$rel_depth         <- nd$depth - nodes$depth[row_of(subroot)]
  
  focal_in_panel  <- intersect(focal_leaves, nd$id[nd$terminal])
  zoom_ids_int    <- as.integer(names(zoom_links))
  focal_ancestors <- unique(c(
    unlist(lapply(focal_in_panel, ancestor_ids, stop_at = subroot)),
    unlist(lapply(intersect(zoom_ids_int, nd$id), ancestor_ids, stop_at = subroot))
  ))
  nd$is_focal_leaf <- nd$id %in% focal_in_panel
  
  counter <- 0L
  yy <- new.env(parent = emptyenv())
  locate <- function(id) {
    kids <- ed$to[ed$from == id]
    if (length(kids) == 0L) {
      counter <<- counter + 1L
      y <- as.numeric(counter) * y_step
    } else {
      y <- mean(vapply(kids, locate, numeric(1L)))
    }
    assign(as.character(id), y, envir = yy)
    y
  }
  locate(subroot)
  
  nd$x <- nd$rel_depth * x_step
  nd$y <- -vapply(nd$id, function(id) get(as.character(id), envir = yy), numeric(1L))
  
  from_idx <- match(ed$from, nd$id)
  to_idx   <- match(ed$to, nd$id)
  
  ed$x            <- nd$x[from_idx]
  ed$y            <- nd$y[from_idx]
  ed$xend         <- nd$x[to_idx]
  ed$yend         <- nd$y[to_idx]
  ed$to_leaf_like <- nd$is_leaf_like[to_idx]
  ed$is_focal     <- (ed$from %in% focal_ancestors) & (ed$to %in% focal_ancestors)
  
  ed$xmid <- ifelse(
    ed$to_leaf_like,
    ed$x + 0.31 * (ed$xend - ed$x),
    ed$x + 0.48 * (ed$xend - ed$x)
  )
  ed$label_x <- ifelse(
    ed$to_leaf_like,
    ed$xmid + 0.49 * (ed$xend - ed$xmid),
    ed$xend
  )
  ed$label_y <- ifelse(
    ed$to_leaf_like,
    ed$yend,
    ed$yend + internal_lift
  )
  
  list(
    nodes     = nd,
    edges     = ed,
    subroot   = subroot,
    n_rows    = sum(nd$is_leaf_like),
    max_depth = max(nd$rel_depth, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
}

# --- Panel (a) ---
short_leaves_a <- unname(all_5_largest[c("cai3", "cai5")])
panel_a_core <- unique(c(
  root_id,
  nodes$id[!nodes$terminal & nodes$depth <= UPPER_DEPTH],
  unlist(lapply(short_leaves_a, ancestor_ids, stop_at = root_id))
))
temp_a    <- make_subtree_display(root_id, panel_a_core, all_focal_leaves)
cai4_anc  <- ancestor_ids(all_5_largest[["cai4"]], stop_at = root_id)
subroot_b <- intersect(temp_a$nodes$id[temp_a$nodes$collapsed], cai4_anc)
if (length(subroot_b) != 1L) stop("Could not uniquely identify subroot for Panel (b).")

panel_a <- make_subtree_display(
  subroot       = root_id,
  core_ids      = panel_a_core,
  focal_leaves  = short_leaves_a,
  zoom_links    = stats::setNames("see Panel (b)", as.character(subroot_b)),
  x_step        = 3.55,
  y_step        = 1.50,
  internal_lift = 0.65
)

# --- Panel (b) ---

panel_b_core <- ancestor_ids(cai4_leaf, stop_at = subroot_b)
temp_b       <- make_subtree_display(subroot_b, panel_b_core, cai4_leaf)

subroot_c       <- intersect(temp_b$nodes$id[temp_b$nodes$collapsed], temporal_anc)
if (length(subroot_c) != 1L) stop("Could not uniquely identify subroot for Panel (c).")

  subroot       = subroot_b,
  core_ids      = panel_b_core,
  focal_leaves  = cai4_leaf,
  zoom_links    = stats::setNames("see Panel (c)", as.character(subroot_c)),

  y_step        = 1.52,
  internal_lift = 0.66
)

# --- Panel (c) ---
panel_c_core <- unique(unlist(lapply(temporal_leaves, ancestor_ids, stop_at = subroot_c)))
panel_c <- make_subtree_display(
  subroot       = subroot_c,
  core_ids      = panel_c_core,
  focal_leaves  = temporal_leaves,

  y_step        = 1.52,

# ------- Display integrity: shown terminals + collapsed subtrees ------------
check_panel_mass <- function(display, expected_n, label) {
  nd <- display$nodes
  shown <- nd[nd$is_leaf_like, , drop = FALSE]
  observed <- sum(shown$n)
  if (observed != expected_n) {
    stop(sprintf("%s: shown terminals + collapsed subtrees = %d, expected %d",
                 label, observed, expected_n))
  }
  cat(sprintf("%s: %d tokens conserved; %d displayed terminal/collapsed boxes\n",
              label, observed, nrow(shown)))
}
check_panel_mass(panel_a, 2000L, "Panel (a)")
check_panel_mass(panel_b, 1177L, "Panel (b)")
check_panel_mass(panel_c, 888L,  "Panel (c)")

# ------- 5. Plotting Engine (100% Identical Visual Style) ---------------------
has_purity_col <- "purity" %in% names(nodes)

plot_publication_panel <- function(
    display,
    panel_title,
    node_text_size = 2.65,
    edge_text_size = 2.05,
    max_edge_chars = 19L,
    left_pad       = 2.45,
    right_pad      = 3.35,
    show_legend    = TRUE
) {
  nd <- display$nodes
  ed <- display$edges
  
  nd$style_key <- ifelse(
    nd$is_zoom_link, "zoom_link",
    ifelse(nd$collapsed, "collapsed",
           ifelse(nd$terminal, tolower(nd$pred_class), "internal"))
  )
  nd$style_key[is.na(nd$style_key)] <- "internal"
  
  nd$label <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(nd)), function(i) {
    v <- nd[i, ]
    if (isTRUE(v$is_zoom_link)) {
      paste0("Node ", v$id, " \u00b7 ", v$zoom_note, "\n",
             "n = ", fmt_n(v$n), " (", v$n_original_leaves, " leaves)")
    } else if (isTRUE(v$collapsed)) {
      paste0("Node ", v$id, " \u00b7 collapsed\n",
             "n = ", fmt_n(v$n), " (", v$n_original_leaves, " leaves)")
    } else if (isTRUE(v$terminal)) {
      pur_str <- if (has_purity_col && !is.na(v$purity)) {
        paste0(" \u00b7 ", sprintf("%.1f%%", as.numeric(v$purity) * 100))
      } else {
        ""
      }
      paste0("Node ", v$id, " \u00b7 ", toupper(v$pred_class), "\n",
             "n = ", fmt_n(v$n), pur_str)
    } else {
      subroot_note <- if (v$id == display$subroot && display$subroot != root_id) {
        paste0(" (n = ", fmt_n(v$n), ")")
      } else {
        ""
      }
      paste0("Node ", v$id, subroot_note, "\n",
             short_variable(v$variable), "\n",
             fmt_p(as.numeric(v$pvalue)))
    }
  }, character(1L))
  
  ed_bg    <- ed[!ed$is_focal, , drop = FALSE]
  ed_focal <- ed[ed$is_focal,  , drop = FALSE]
  
  p <- ggplot2::ggplot()
  
  # 1. Background secondary branches
  if (nrow(ed_bg) > 0L) {
    p <- p +
      ggplot2::geom_segment(data = ed_bg, ggplot2::aes(x = x, y = y, xend = xmid, yend = y),
                            linewidth = 0.35, colour = "#94A3B8", lineend = "square") +
      ggplot2::geom_segment(data = ed_bg, ggplot2::aes(x = xmid, y = y, xend = xmid, yend = yend),
                            linewidth = 0.35, colour = "#94A3B8", lineend = "square") +
      ggplot2::geom_segment(data = ed_bg, ggplot2::aes(x = xmid, y = yend, xend = xend, yend = yend),
                            linewidth = 0.35, colour = "#94A3B8", lineend = "square")
  }
  
  # 2. Highlighted focal pathways
  if (nrow(ed_focal) > 0L) {
    p <- p +
      ggplot2::geom_segment(data = ed_focal, ggplot2::aes(x = x, y = y, xend = xmid, yend = y),
                            linewidth = 0.65, colour = "#334155", lineend = "square") +
      ggplot2::geom_segment(data = ed_focal, ggplot2::aes(x = xmid, y = y, xend = xmid, yend = yend),
                            linewidth = 0.65, colour = "#334155", lineend = "square") +
      ggplot2::geom_segment(data = ed_focal, ggplot2::aes(x = xmid, y = yend, xend = xend, yend = yend),
                            linewidth = 0.65, colour = "#334155", lineend = "square")
  }
  
  # 3. Internal nodes
  nd_internal <- nd[!nd$is_leaf_like, , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(nd_internal) > 0L) {
    p <- p + ggplot2::geom_label(
      data = nd_internal,
      ggplot2::aes(x = x, y = y, label = label, fill = style_key, colour = style_key),
      hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5,
      size = node_text_size, family = "sans", lineheight = 0.92,
      linewidth = 0.36,
      label.padding = grid::unit(0.16, "lines"),
      label.r = grid::unit(0.06, "lines"),
      show.legend = FALSE
    )
  }
  
  # 4. Collapsed / cross-reference subtrees
  nd_collapsed <- nd[nd$is_leaf_like & nd$collapsed & !nd$is_zoom_link, , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(nd_collapsed) > 0L) {
    p <- p + ggplot2::geom_label(
      data = nd_collapsed,
      ggplot2::aes(x = x, y = y, label = label, fill = style_key, colour = style_key),
      hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5,
      size = node_text_size * 0.94, family = "sans", fontface = "italic",
      lineheight = 0.92, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.40,
      label.padding = grid::unit(0.16, "lines"),
      label.r = grid::unit(0.06, "lines"),
      show.legend = FALSE
    )
  }
  
  nd_zoom <- nd[nd$is_leaf_like & nd$is_zoom_link, , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(nd_zoom) > 0L) {
    p <- p + ggplot2::geom_label(
      data = nd_zoom,
      ggplot2::aes(x = x, y = y, label = label, fill = style_key, colour = style_key),
      hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5,
      size = node_text_size * 0.96, family = "sans", fontface = "bold.italic",
      lineheight = 0.92, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.55,
      label.padding = grid::unit(0.16, "lines"),
      label.r = grid::unit(0.06, "lines"),
      show.legend = FALSE
    )
  }
  
  # 5. Terminal leaves
  nd_minor_leaf <- nd[nd$is_leaf_like & nd$terminal & !nd$is_focal_leaf, , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(nd_minor_leaf) > 0L) {
    p <- p + ggplot2::geom_label(
      data = nd_minor_leaf,
      ggplot2::aes(x = x, y = y, label = label, fill = style_key, colour = style_key),
      hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5,
      size = node_text_size * 0.96, family = "sans", fontface = "plain",
      lineheight = 0.92, linewidth = 0.38,
      label.padding = grid::unit(0.16, "lines"),
      label.r = grid::unit(0.06, "lines"),
      show.legend = FALSE
    )
  }
  
  nd_focal_leaf <- nd[nd$is_leaf_like & nd$terminal & nd$is_focal_leaf, , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(nd_focal_leaf) > 0L) {
    p <- p + ggplot2::geom_label(
      data = nd_focal_leaf,
      ggplot2::aes(x = x, y = y, label = label, fill = style_key, colour = style_key),
      hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5,
      size = node_text_size * 1.02, family = "sans", fontface = "bold",
      lineheight = 0.92, linewidth = 0.72,
      label.padding = grid::unit(0.18, "lines"),
      label.r = grid::unit(0.06, "lines"),
      show.legend = FALSE
    )
  }
  
  # 6. Branch category labels (thin rectangular box preserved)
  if (isTRUE(SHOW_BRANCH_LABELS)) {
    raw_txt <- as.character(ed$branch_label)
    missing_txt <- is.na(raw_txt) | !nzchar(raw_txt)
    raw_txt[missing_txt] <- ed$branch[missing_txt]
    ed$edge_text <- clean_edge_label(raw_txt, max_chars = max_edge_chars)
    
    ed_int  <- ed[!ed$to_leaf_like, , drop = FALSE]
    ed_leaf <- ed[ed$to_leaf_like,  , drop = FALSE]
    
    if (nrow(ed_int) > 0L) {
      p <- p + ggplot2::geom_label(
        data = ed_int,
        ggplot2::aes(x = label_x, y = label_y, label = edge_text),
        hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0,
        size = edge_text_size, family = "sans",
        colour = "#475569", fill = "white", linewidth = 0,
        label.padding = grid::unit(0.04, "lines"),
        label.r = grid::unit(0, "lines")
      )
    }
    
    if (nrow(ed_leaf) > 0L) {
      p <- p + ggplot2::geom_label(
        data = ed_leaf,
        ggplot2::aes(x = label_x, y = label_y, label = edge_text),
        hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5,
        size = edge_text_size, family = "sans",
        colour = "#475569", fill = "white", linewidth = 0,
        label.padding = grid::unit(0.04, "lines"),
        label.r = grid::unit(0, "lines")
      )
    }
  }
  
  # 7. Sense legend bar
  sense_breaks <- c("cai1", "cai2", "cai3", "cai4", "cai5")
  sense_labels <- c("CAI1 (recent)", "CAI2 (delay)", "CAI3 (low)",
                    "CAI4 (prerequisite)", "CAI5 (emphatic)")
  
  if (isTRUE(show_legend)) {
    dummy_leg <- data.frame(
      x     = mean(nd$x, na.rm = TRUE),
      y     = mean(nd$y, na.rm = TRUE),
      sense = factor(sense_breaks, levels = sense_breaks)
    )
    p <- p + ggplot2::geom_point(
      data = dummy_leg,
      ggplot2::aes(x = x, y = y, fill = sense, colour = sense),
      shape = 22, size = 0, alpha = 0, show.legend = TRUE
    )
  }
  
  p +
    ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(
      values = fill_palette,
      breaks = sense_breaks,
      labels = sense_labels,
      name   = "Predicted sense:"
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_colour_manual(
      values = border_text_palette,
      breaks = sense_breaks,
      labels = sense_labels,
      name   = "Predicted sense:"
    ) +
    ggplot2::guides(
      fill = if (show_legend) {
        ggplot2::guide_legend(
          override.aes = list(shape = 22, size = 4.2, alpha = 1, stroke = 0.85)
        )
      } else "none",
      colour = if (show_legend) ggplot2::guide_legend() else "none"
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(
      expand = ggplot2::expansion(add = c(left_pad, right_pad))
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(
      expand = ggplot2::expansion(add = c(0.55, 0.62))
    ) +
    ggplot2::coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
    ggplot2::labs(title = panel_title) +
    ggplot2::theme_void(base_size = 9.5, base_family = "sans") +
    ggplot2::theme(
      plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(
        size = 9.8, face = "bold", hjust = 0, colour = "#0F172A",
        margin = ggplot2::margin(b = 3)
      ),
      legend.position      = "top",
      legend.justification = "left",
      legend.direction     = "horizontal",
      legend.title         = ggplot2::element_text(size = 8.4, face = "bold", colour = "#1E293B"),
      legend.text          = ggplot2::element_text(size = 8.2, colour = "#1E293B"),
      legend.key.size      = grid::unit(0.40, "cm"),
      legend.box.spacing   = grid::unit(0.05, "cm"),
      legend.margin        = ggplot2::margin(t = 0, b = 0, unit = "pt"),
      plot.margin          = ggplot2::margin(6, 10, 6, 10, "pt")
    )
}

save_standalone_panel <- function(p, stem, width_cm, height_cm) {
  w_in <- width_cm / 2.54
  h_in <- height_cm / 2.54
  
  ggplot2::ggsave(file.path(OUT_DIR, paste0(stem, ".pdf")), p,
                  width = w_in, height = h_in, units = "in", device = grDevices::cairo_pdf)
  
  grDevices::png(file.path(OUT_DIR, paste0(stem, "_600dpi.png")),
                 width = w_in, height = h_in, units = "in", res = 600, bg = "white", type = "cairo")
  print(p)
  grDevices::dev.off()
  
  grDevices::tiff(file.path(OUT_DIR, paste0(stem, "_600dpi.tiff")),
                  width = w_in, height = h_in, units = "in", res = 600, compression = "lzw", bg = "white")
  print(p)
  grDevices::dev.off()
}

# ------- 6. Generate & Save Three Separate Standalone Figures -----------------

# Figure 5a: Balanced 18.0 cm width + generous left_pad = 2.40 (zero clipping!)
p_a <- plot_publication_panel(
  panel_a,
  "(a) Main upper-level structure and complete routes to CAI3 (Node 63) and CAI5 (Node 67)",
  node_text_size = 2.65,
  edge_text_size = 2.05,
  max_edge_chars = 20L,
  left_pad       = 2.40,
  right_pad      = 3.30,
  show_legend    = TRUE
)
h_a_cm <- max(9.2, panel_a$n_rows * 1.28 + 1.3)
save_standalone_panel(p_a, "Fig_05a_Upper_CAI3_CAI5", width_cm = 18.0, height_cm = h_a_cm)

# Figure 5b: Node 11 expansion -> CAI4 (#57), left_pad = 2.55 protects wide "Node 11 (n = 1,177)" box
p_b <- plot_publication_panel(
  panel_b,
  paste0("(b) Subtree expansion from Node ", subroot_b, " tracing the route to CAI4 (Node 57)"),
  node_text_size = 2.52,
  edge_text_size = 1.95,
  max_edge_chars = 16L,
  left_pad       = 2.55,
  right_pad      = 3.65,
  show_legend    = TRUE
)
h_b_cm <- max(9.4, panel_b$n_rows * 1.30 + 1.3)
save_standalone_panel(p_b, "Fig_05b_Node11_CAI4", width_cm = 18.8, height_cm = h_b_cm)

# Figure 5c: Node 12 expansion -> CAI1 (#24, #29) & CAI2 (#47)
c_depth_scale <- if (panel_c$max_depth >= 6L) 0.94 else 1.00
p_c <- plot_publication_panel(
  panel_c,
  paste0("(c) Subtree expansion from Node ", subroot_c,
         " tracing routes to CAI1 (Nodes 24, 29) and CAI2 (Node 47)"),
  node_text_size = 2.52 * c_depth_scale,
  edge_text_size = 1.95 * c_depth_scale,
  max_edge_chars = 15L,
  left_pad       = 2.55,
  right_pad      = 3.75,
  show_legend    = TRUE
)
h_c_cm <- max(10.2, panel_c$n_rows * 1.28 + 1.3)
save_standalone_panel(p_c, "Fig_05c_Node12_CAI1_CAI2", width_cm = 19.2, height_cm = h_c_cm)

message("All 3 figures exported cleanly without clipping to: ", normalizePath(OUT_DIR))
